newsitem.title: TURKEY: Rebel Kurds attack convoy of Turkish officials.
newsitem.headline: Rebel Kurds attack convoy of Turkish officials.

text.p: Rebel Kurds attacked a convoy of local officials and security forces in southeastern Turkey on Tuesday, security sources said. There were no reports of casualties.

A group of Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrillas using rocket launchers and automatic weapons attacked a convoy carrying Idil district governor Huseyin Parlak and other officials at 5 p.m. (1400 GMT), officials said.
The rebels escaped after a half-hour fire-fight with the military escort. Security forces launched an operation in pursuit of the attackers.
More than 24,000 lives have been lost in Turkey's struggle against the PKK which has been fighting for Kurdish autonomy or independence since 1984.
